A '''store''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Barons Hed]], located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. It was operated by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Unidentified Barons Hed storeowner|merchant]].<ref name="DF2" /> After the arrival of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], who briefly governed the city, the store became one of the few non-[[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] establishments to have not shut its doors.<ref name="DFG">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> The woman was once harassed by a pair of [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. A supporter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the woman kept the store stocked with various kinds of weaponry, which were all located in a hidden room behind the main desk.<ref name="DF2" />
